Package grpcdc

Class Codec

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.Codec
public final class Codec extends Object
Frame codec for gRPC over WebRTC DataChannels (wire protocol in ../SPEC.md). Frame, status, channel and server semantics mirror the Rust, JavaScript, Go and Python runtimes; the tables in Wire.java are generated by grpc-dc codegen.
